headline: New Common VIC licenses for Los Compadres Restaurant and El Piloncito Supermarket, plus a complaint against Eleven Kitchen & Bar.
summary: The board will review two new Common VIC license applications, hear a complaint about Eleven Kitchen & Bar regarding ownership, management, and liquor license and outdoor dining, and consider a tabled liquor license transfer for Father & Son DBA Envy Lounge.
items: New Business - LICENSE #VIC26-000033 - Los Compadres Restaurant, LLC applying for a Common VIC at 107 Union St, former D' Lizardo Restaurant. Representing: Danny Ferreiras

New Business - LICENSE #VIC26-000032 - El Piloncito Supermarket & Restaurant applying for a Common VIC License at 179-183 Jackson St, former Bonanza Supermarket & Restaurant. Representing: Rosanny M Sanchez

New Complaint - YH Enterprise INC DBA Eleven Kitchen & Bar - Complaint regarding new ownership, management, and Liquor License, and outdoor dining arrangements. By Commissioner Laird. Representing: Yoel Herrera

Tabled on 9/23/2026 - LICENSE #LL26-000039 - Father & Son DBA Envy Lounge applying to transfer their existing Liquor License to Kathan LLC DBA Rumba Bar & Lounge. Representing: Marisol Rodriguez/Brian Corrigan
location: City Hall Chambers Room 105, 200 Common St, Lawrence, MA 01840
